title: "Lock-in" Box
description: A phone box submitted for the IEEE SSCS Arduino Contest's prompt "Solutions to Everyday Challenges". Along with the ability to set a time that the box will be locked for, a reed switch circuit checks for tampering and an IMU detects phone vibration to unlock the box (i.e. for emergencies). Version 2 features a much (, much) better design with a custom PCB and new box parts modeled in Onshape (neither of which I knew how to make before!).

title: Science Olympiad Electric Vehicle
description: My first experience with electronics! I participated in the Electric Vehicle event of Science Olympiad, where I was responsible for finding and putting together the electronic parts and programming the robot, which was done from scratch and on a relatively low level. Learned a ton about Arduino, PID, how to solder, motor selection, etc.
